Unique event + user; last active ED protected
No plain tokens in business exports
Target exists in same event; no wildcard grant by default
No overlapping active managers for one school
Default one active pool per volunteer
One current primary scorer and accountable reviewer
Unique event + athlete and event + code
Unique team + entry; competition and school agree
No public object URLs; content/type/size validation
Key scoped to actor + event + command
Unique job + row; retry preserves successes
No inferred age assignment from sprint distance
Unique discipline + event + version; approved content immutable
Pin form and calculator with result
Exactly one entry_id or team_id; unique fixture + slot
No cycle; one resolved source per target slot
Unique active physical slot per fixture
Positive quantity; no duplicate entitlement issue by default
Atomic stock control; no silent negative balance
Unique scorecard + revision; submitted content frozen
Append observations; prevent duplicate logical outcome
One current final classification per participant and revision
